correctness.rationale: All definitions and normalization are specified. Exact trigonometric antiderivatives give the two parabolas; sign factorizations of dual quadratics prove the two sharp deficit equalities and all a.e.-unique extremizers. Weak-* compactness plus a four-piece perturbation establishes indicator realization of every interior point. Rotations plus the polarization identity give both complex disk bounds. A standalone checker passed 41,864 corroborating assertions; finite checks are not used to establish the continuum theorem.

Independently sharp rotationally covariant complex bounds constrain the first two Toeplitz aperture off-diagonals. This is a natural complete trigonometric moment classification, not a value from arbitrary table recomputation; it has mathematically motivated utility beyond the checker.
